_doc: Tunables for derive_team_playstyle_empirical.py. See docs/playstyle_empirical_design.md. Coordinates: StatsBomb normalised, each team attacks +x, own goal x=0, pitch 120x80.

ppda_zone._doc: def_action_min_x = pressing team's attacking 60% (>=48 = outside own 40%); opp_pass_max_x = building team's own 60% (<=72). Same physical strip.

wing_channels._doc: Wide lanes on the 80-wide pitch (outer ~22% each side). attacking_half_min_x restricts to attacking width (x>=60) so central buildup doesn't dilute the signal; half not third, since wide players receive near halfway.

line_height._doc: Median x of BACK-LINE players' defensive engagements. Excludes Clearance/Block (deep last-ditch) and DM/GK.

_ppda_note: Tackles come from type='Duel' AND raw.duel.type.name='Tackle' (Duel is ~50% aerials). Pressure/Ball Recovery deliberately excluded from PPDA.
